card.name: Immediate use after dilution wording
card.fires_on: The word that completes phrases about using or giving a prepared product right away, such as "as soon as feasible" or "if immediate use is not possible". It appears in dilution and storage instructions.

modes.label: As soon as feasible
modes.description: Final word of "as soon after preparation as is feasible" in admixture guidance.
modes.example: should be administered as soon after preparation as is<< feasible>>. c) Using aseptic technique

modes.label: If immediate use is not possible
modes.description: The word "not" or "possible" in the fallback clause that leads into storage conditions.
